RopesThe yard

Rope, laid by hand

Three-strand manila and hemp, laid on a 60-metre walk in the old harbour since the yard reopened.

Order a coil

Laid on the walk

Each coil is twisted along the full length of the walk, so a rope is never spliced to reach its length. Order by the metre, collect at the yard on Fridays.

What we lay

  • Manila, 12 mm For moorings and rails, sold by the metre.
  • Hemp, 8 mm Soft in the hand, for bell ropes and garden work.
  • Tarred marline For whipping and seizing, on spools.

Open Fridays

The yard is open to visitors on Fridays from nine to four. Walk the length of the rope walk and watch a coil being laid.

Order a coil

Write to the yard with the fibre, the thickness and the length you need. We reply with the price and a Friday for collection.
